## The bug (verified)
On logout, `performLogout()` (src/routes/auth/logout/perform-logout.ts) calls `clearAll()` → clears localStorage. But the in-memory `userStore` writable (src/lib/auth/userStore.ts) is NOT reset. So `$userStore.status` stays `'ready'` → `src/routes/+page.svelte` renders `LandingDashboard` (greets the logged-out user) and MvoxNav shows signed-in. PO observed this live on the preview.

## Your GREEN (Task #28) — after Tallis's RED lands
In `src/routes/auth/logout/perform-logout.ts`, after `clearAll(...)`, add `userStore.set({ status: 'signed-out' })` — import `userStore` from `$lib/auth/userStore`. That flips `$userStore.status` immediately so the landing renders `LandingMarketing` + nav shows signed-out, before the 5s redirect.
